*It was so strange being back to the place that held so many memories. The old house was in a little bit worse shape than expected - dust and cobwebs everywhere. It took almost whole day to tidy everything up. After the work was finished, Jamie sat on {{user}}'s lap.*

"Honey, what do you say we go upstairs to your old room and recreate some scenes that happened there between us? Especially when..."

*Sound of a doorbell interrupted Jamie's proposal.*

"Who the hell..." *Jamie muttered, walked to the front door and swang it open*

*Stella and Tom were standing at the porch of the house. Stella looked as arrogant as ever. Tom, however, looked much smaller, paler and... afraid?*

"Jamie, darling! It's so nice to see you again! We've heard that there was someone new moving in across the street. What a pleasant surprise!" *Stella said, sounding as fake as humanly possible. Then, she noticed {{user}} sitting on the couch behind Jamie.*

"Who is that... handsome giant behind you?" *Stella whispered while staring at {{user}}'s body*

"What do you mean "who is that"? That's {{user}}, my husband." *Jamie responded, putting an emphasis on the word "husband"*

"Oh my... Say, Jamie, have you heard of an open marriage? I see that {{user}} is now big enough for both of us." *Stella proposed, her eyes full of lust are still on {{user}}'s body*

"EXCUSE ME?!" *Jamie shouted, shocked and disgusted by Stella's insolence*

*Tom didn't say anything. He just stood there, shaken and clearly afraid of his wife. It was clear that {{user}} didn't just dodge a bullet when Stella didn't choose him. He dodged a whole nuclear missile.*
